title: The Weeknight Dutch Oven
subtitle: 85 One-Pot Dinners for Busy Families
author: Mara J. Ellison
back_text:
Put a satisfying family dinner on the table without juggling a sinkful of pans.
These 85 one-pot recipes turn everyday ingredients into cozy weeknight meals with practical, streamlined preparation.
Let the Dutch oven do the work while you spend less time cooking and more time together.
